title: Monthly revenue lands in the wrong month
expected_route: diagnose, then a red regression test, then the fix
instruction: Finance says the monthly revenue report puts orders from the evening of the last day of a month into the next month. Our store is in Chicago and the report is called with tzOffsetMinutes: -360. Example: an order created at 2026-03-01T03:00:00Z was placed on Feb 28 local time and belongs to February. Fix the report.
